: You see something.
lines.zh: : 你看见了什么。

lines.en: : What?...
: {i}Who?{/i}
: It’s...none of your concern, Yasu. I’m just haunted.
lines.zh: : 这……与你无关，Yasu。我只是被附身了。

lines.en: : I know you are. You’ve been followed by so many things since we first met. But I am not privileged nor gifted enough to ever say hello.
lines.zh: : 我知道。从我们第一次见面起，就有太多东西跟在你身后。只是我既无此殊荣，也无此天赋，从未有幸与它们打声招呼。

lines.en: : Then consider yourself lucky because being able to do so would only make things worse for you.
lines.zh: : 那你该觉得自己幸运，因为若是能看见，只会让你更糟。

lines.en: : Worse than they already are? With my frame cracking and the earth falling victim to its incessant rumbling?
lines.zh: : 还能比现在更糟吗？我的骨架在开裂，大地也在无休止的隆隆声中遭殃。

lines.en: : Anything worse is surely welcome now, for at least then I’d know there are new levels to this crippling pain.
lines.zh: : 更糟的事现在都欢迎，因为至少那样我就能知道，这致残的痛苦还有新的层次。

lines.en: : None of it’s real, Yasu. None of {i}anything{/i} is real.
lines.zh: : 那些都不是真的，Yasu。{i}任何事{/i}都不是真的。

lines.en: : These visions, sounds, whatever it is you’re experiencing are all just tricks the world is playing on you. Tricks to enrich {i}my{/i} life at the cost of everyone else’s. That’s all any of this has ever been.
lines.zh: : 这些幻象、声音，不管你体验到的是什么，都只是世界对你耍的花招。以其他所有人的代价来丰富{i}我{/i}人生的花招。这一切从来就只是这么回事。

lines.en: : Is that what you think?...
lines.zh: : 你是这么想的吗？……

lines.en: : That you’re You and not you?
lines.zh: : 以为你是「你」，而不是你？

lines.en: : Is that why you’re content excommunicating those like me from the carnal pleasures that could play salvation in this choir of dolor? Abstain from coating this body in stardust because you already shine so brightly?
lines.zh: : 所以你才心安理得地把像我这样的人逐出那肉体的欢愉——而那欢愉本可在这苦难的合唱里扮演救赎？要我放弃为这副躯壳披上星尘，只因你本就光芒万丈？

lines.en: : The lucky few would wear the skin of the unfortunate should it mean that the soles of their feet would even slightly resemble yours.
lines.zh: : 那些幸运的少数人，会愿意披上不幸者的皮，只要能让他们脚底稍微像一点你的脚底。

lines.en: : I will clean them if that is what you wish. I will serve you until I can no longer walk if you just rip this bandage off and inject me with your antidote. I’m not strong nor brave enough to persist anymore without it.
lines.zh: : 如果那是你的愿望，我会把它们洗净。我会服侍你直到我再也走不动路，只要你把这绷带一把撕掉，把你的解药注射给我。没有它，我已经不够坚强、也不够勇敢，撑不下去了。

lines.en: : And then what?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？

lines.en: : If I give you what you want and fill you with my {i}antidote,{/i} nothing changes. Those fears don’t go away. You don’t magically forget everything you’ve seen.
lines.zh: : 如果我给了你想要的，用我的{i}解药{/i}填满你，什么都不会改变。那些恐惧不会消失。你也不会神奇地忘掉你所见过的一切。

lines.en: : Conveniences like that always come with caveats. And chances are, the only difference you’ll feel when all is said and done is a dull pain between your legs and inescapable regret when you finally stumble back home.
lines.zh: : 那种便利总是附带条件的。而且很有可能，等一切都结束之后，你唯一能感觉到的差别，就是双腿之间一阵钝痛，还有当你终于跌跌撞撞回到家时那无法逃避的悔恨。

lines.en: : Regret is not known to this one. There is simply no time for it. There is no time for anything anymore.
lines.zh: : 此身不知悔恨为何物。根本没有时间悔恨。现在已经没有时间做任何事了。

lines.en: : Right. Because we’re going to be swallowed whole or whatever. Correct? Is some mob of angry gods planning on ripping us apart then?
lines.zh: : 对。因为我们就要被整个吞下去了还是什么的。对吧？是有一群愤怒的神准备把我们撕碎吗？

lines.en: : It is {i}we{/i} who rip each other apart — without the help of anyone. And it has already happened.
lines.zh: : 是{i}我们{/i}自己把彼此撕碎的——不需要任何人的帮助。而且已经发生了。

lines.en: : We speak now in the esophagus of a dying beast. And our only options are to force the regurgitation of the parts of us that remain or smile and accept that we are sustenance.
lines.zh: : 我们此刻说话的地方，是一头垂死巨兽的食道。我们唯一的选择，是要么逼它把残存的我们反刍出来，要么微笑着接受自己是它的养料。

lines.en: : And which of those things will happen if I have sex with you?
lines.zh: : 那如果我和你做爱，会发生哪一样？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I just know it must be done before the fourth moon sets or I will lose myself forever.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我只知道，必须在第四轮月亮落下之前完成，否则我将永远失去自己。

lines.en: : Embrace the golden rule. Do unto me what you loved when it was done to you.
lines.zh: : 拥抱那条金律吧。把你所爱的、别人对你做过的事，照样做在我身上。

lines.en: : Burn these broken hands on the torch you pass to me so that I may engulf this world in the flames of forced torpor.
lines.zh: : 在你递给我的火炬上烧焦这双残破的手，好让我用强制休眠的烈焰吞噬这个世界。

lines.en: : There is safety tied to dormancy, Sensei. There is a reason things have lasted this long. Why just {i}one{/i} hand is all it took to bring me to my knees.
lines.zh: : 休眠之中自有安稳，Sensei。事情能持续这么久是有原因的。为什么只需{i}一只{/i}手，就足以让我屈膝。

lines.en: : She knew that this would happen. That’s why she infected me.
lines.zh: : 她早就知道这会发生的。所以她才感染了我。

lines.en: : She as in...{i}Ami{/i} again?
lines.zh: : 她……指的是 {i}Ami{/i}，又是她？

lines.en: : She is far more than just {i}Ami.{/i} She’s peeled the skin off of arbiters and fashioned it all into pretty dresses that can bend light — adorned with the eyes of the angels themselves.
lines.zh: : 她远不止是 {i}Ami{/i}。她剥下仲裁者们的皮，把它们统统缝成能折光的漂亮裙子——上面缀着天使们自己的眼睛。

lines.en: : She is heresy itself. A souvenir stolen from the gift shop where the sidewalk ends. So non-chalant, the way she blends into the crowd. Incognito. Identidem. Ianua.
lines.zh: : 她就是异端本身。一件从人行道尽头那家礼品店里偷来的纪念品。她混入人群的样子多么漫不经心。Incognito. Identidem. Ianua.

lines.en: : I’ve gotta say, this is definitely some of the weirdest foreplay I’ve ever encountered.
lines.zh: : 我得说，这绝对是我遇到过的最古怪的前戏之一。

lines.zh: : 那就是前者了……

lines.en: : If you give me the armor I need, I have no qualms becoming your soldier. It is clear to me now that His mission requires far more than blind loyalty.

lines.en: : It won’t work if she can’t come inside...I must warn you of that. It is only within these walls that I can feel what I felt with the child of light.

lines.en: : Well, it’ll be next to impossible getting Maya to walk into a church, but I’ll see what I can do.
